wakeUpDivider.title: Wake Up Divider
wakeUpDivider.description: To have 1 Hz period, RTCCLK is divided by (PREDIV_A+1)*(PREDIV_S+1). With the LSE clock, RTCCLK = 32768 Hz, so PREDIV_A must be equal to 127 and PREDIV_S must be equal to 255.

oneOf.title: Divider 16
Divider 8
Divider 4
Divider 2
Divider to have 1 Hz period
Divider to have 1 Hz period with 1 bit added

attributes.description: Number of periods before wake up. Value must be between 1 and 65535. With a divider 2, wake up counter cannot be equal to 0. The minimum wake up time is 122us.
Number of periods before wake up. Value must be between 0 and 65535.
Number of periods before wake up. Value must be between 65536 and 131071.

computed.const: ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter + 1)) >= 3600 ? Math.floor(($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter + 1)) / 3600) + ' h ' + Math.floor((($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter + 1)) % 3600) / 60) + ' min ' + (($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter + 1)) % 60) + ' s' : ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter + 1)) >= 60 ? Math.floor(($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter + 1)) / 60) + ' min ' + (($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter + 1)) % 60) + ' s' : ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter + 1)) + ' s'

clearFlagCounter.title: Clear Flag Counter
clearFlagCounter.description: If Clear Flag Counter is equal to 0 then WUTF must be cleared by the software. Otherwise, WUTF will be automatically cleared by the hardware at Clear Flag Time after Wake Up Time. Value must be between 0 and Wake Up Counter.

clearFlagTime.title: Clear Flag Time
clearFlagTime.description: Delay before clear wakeup timer flag.

computed.const: ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter - $additionalFeatures.wakeUp.clearFlagCounter + 1)) >= 3600 ? Math.floor(($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter - $additionalFeatures.wakeUp.clearFlagCounter + 1)) / 3600) + ' h ' + Math.floor((($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter - $additionalFeatures.wakeUp.clearFlagCounter + 1)) % 3600) / 60) + ' min ' + (($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter - $additionalFeatures.wakeUp.clearFlagCounter + 1)) % 60) + ' s' : ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter - $additionalFeatures.wakeUp.clearFlagCounter + 1)) >= 60 ? Math.floor(($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter - $additionalFeatures.wakeUp.clearFlagCounter + 1)) / 60) + ' min ' + (($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter - $additionalFeatures.wakeUp.clearFlagCounter + 1)) % 60) + ' s' : ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpMinimumPeriod * ($additionalFeatures.wakeUp.wakeUpCounter - $additionalFeatures.wakeUp.clearFlagCounter + 1)) + ' s'
